programs.title: The Makery
programs.desc: Nim makes a volcano picture, bakes a lemon tart chicken, and creates a delicious-looking juice box costume. She also helps The Makery cure the hiccups!

programs.title: Play School: Rainforest Rangers
programs.desc: Rangers Leah and Luke show us how we can all help care for the rainforest. They build a walkway to help protect plants and animals, make a tasty snack using macadamia nuts and figs, and clear weeds from the forest floor.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Lucia and Simon are in the Wiggly Kitchen and come across an egg. Sing along to a nursery rhyme favourite 'Humpty Dumpty'. Now Simon and Lucia have three cracked eggs and they can't waste them, what to do?

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Fizzy and Suds meet a bee and follow it home to it's hive! They watch bees collect nectar, make honey, protect the hive, and care for babies - all in their buzzing bee kingdom.

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: Miffy and Baby Bun are ready for their big adventure, hiking and camping in the woods! But the car has broken down, and they are stuck on the road.

programs.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programs.desc: The baby Pea-Rexess are fighting over who gets to play with their recently discovered rock, seeing the squabble, Ginger arranges a timeshare deal, letting each of their personalities shine.

programs.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programs.desc: Andy travels back in time 106 million years, to the time of leaellynasaura - a dinosaur that lived in Australia. His mission - to find some broken egg shells from the nest of a mother leaellynasaura.

programs.title: Santiago of the Seas
programs.desc: Tomas accidentally turns Abuelo into a chicken!

programs.title: Mojo Swoptops
programs.desc: Is there a monster in Lake Swoppiton? Mojo and Bo help Bryan be brave to find out!

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum are enjoying playing Keepy-Uppy around the house with their last balloon, when Dad joins in and the game becomes the ultimate test of skill.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Peppa and her family are going for a walk in the countryside and end up climbing a big hill. When they get to the top there is a wonderful view.
